source: 798 Hire
target: 798 Conduce

source: Lez looked at Lumian with confusion and asked, “Can you make decisions for the owner here?”
target: Lez, confuso animo Luminum contemplatus, quaesivit: “Potesne hic pro domino decernere?”

source: “Yes, because I am the owner now,” Lumian replied with a smile, pointing to himself.
target: “Ita, nam nunc ego dominus sum,” respondit Lumian subrisu, ad se ipsum demonstrans.

source: The human meat chef, Lez, was even more perplexed.
target: Lez, coquus carnium humanarum, adhuc magis perplexus erat.

source: “Weren’t we just exiled to Morora together?”
target: “Nonne modo una in Morora exsulati sumus?”

source: It had been less than an hour since they arrived.
target: Ex quo advenissent, minus quam una hora praeterierat.

source: Lumian tilted his head and pointed his chin towards the destroyed bar area.
target: Lumian caput inclinavit et mentum suum ad aream tabernae deleta indicavit.

source: “I had a duel with the previous owner and won this bar from him.”
target: “Certamen cum priore domino habueram atque hanc tabernam ab eo vici.”

source: Lez’s eyes suddenly lit up.
target: Oculi Lez subito fulserunt.

source: “Is he dead? Where’s his body?”
target: “Num mortuus est? Ubi eius corpus est?”

source: “The enforcers took it away, probably to be buried in the cemetery,” Lumian said, walking to the edge of the hall and picking up a relatively intact chair, placing it next to the ruined bar.
target: “Custodes id abstulerunt, verisimiliter ad sepelendum in coemeterio,” inquit Lumian, ad limitem aulae ambulans et sellam satis intactam tollens eamque iuxta tabernam ruinam ponens.

source: Lez sighed regretfully but followed Lumian’s suggestion and went into the kitchen to start cooking.
target: Lez tristiter suspiravit, sed consilio Lumiani se secutus in culinam ivit ad coquendum.

source: Lumian wandered to the bar area, searching for the two “steaks” he and Albus hadn’t eaten.
target: Lumian ad aream tabernae vagatus est, duo frusta carnis quaerens, quae ipse atque Albus non ediderant.

source: They were torn to pieces in the violent explosion, scattered among the debris, completely charred and carbonized.
target: Illae in violenta explosione in partes disiectae erant, inter ruinas sparsae, omnino exusta atque carbonatae.

source: After examining them for a while, Lumian noticed that the steak fragments showed no signs of writhing or regeneration.
target: Postquam aliquantisper ea examinavit, Lumian animadvertit fragmenta carnis nullas signa motus aut regenerationis exhibere.

source: The fire had destroyed any subtle connection to the corpse, making them seem entirely dead and no longer part of the Abscessed Hand.
target: Ignis omnem levem nexum ad cadaver destruxit, ita ut videbantur omnino mortui et non amplius pars “Manus Abscessae” essent.

source: These probably don’t need to be recalled…
target: Haec fortasse non sunt revocanda.

source: High-temperature flames can restrain the self-healing ability of the separated rotten flesh, but it’s unclear how much it affects the corpse itself…
target: Flammae altae temperaturae facultatem auto-sanandi carnis putrescentis separatae reprimere possunt, sed incertum est quantum ipsa cadaver afficiat.

source: Besides, the separated rotten flesh must only have a limited self-healing ability; otherwise, each piece could grow into a new Hand Bro, and there’d be no need for Hand Bro to find the whole corpse…
target: Praeterea, carnis putrescentis separatae facultas auto-sanandi limitata esse debet; alioquin, quaelibet pars in novum “Manus Frater” crescere posset, et opus non esset ut “Manus Frater” totum cadaver inveniret.

source: After pondering for a while, Lumian brought over a small overturned round table from the edge of the hall and placed it next to the chair.
target: Postquam paulisper cogitavit, Lumian parvam mensam rotundam deorsum versa ex extremitate aulae attulit et iuxta sellam posuit.

source: He sat down, patiently waiting for Lez to prepare lunch.
target: Sedit, patienter exspectans ut Lez prandium praepararet.

source: As time passed, Lez brought out a mixed salad, creamy mashed potatoes, and other dishes.
target: Tempore transacto, Lez acetariam mixtam, cremosa puram solanorum, et alia fercula eduxit.

source: Lumian took a spoonful of mashed potatoes and tasted it, finding the texture unusually smooth and the flavors of starch, cream, and fat deliciously combined.
target: Lumian cochlearem puri solanorum sumpsit et gustavit, inveniens texturam insolitam lenem atque sapores amylum, cremor, et adipum sapide coniunctos.

source: “Not bad,” Lumian said, raising his left hand and giving a thumbs up.
target: “Non male,” inquit Lumian, manum sinistram levans et pollice probans.

source: Lez stood beside him, smiling humbly.
target: Lez iuxta eum stetit, humiliter subridens.

source: “I used to own a restaurant.”
target: “Olim cauponam possidebam.”

source: “A restaurant specializing in human meat?” Lumian teased provocatively.
target: “Taberna quae carnem humanam praecipue parabat?” provocavit Lumian.

source: Lez shook his head.
target: Lez caput agitavit.

source: “Back then, I was a normal chef with excellent, but still human, cooking skills.”
target: “Illo tempore, eram coquus ordinarius cum optimis, sed humanis, artibus culinariis.”

source: “Then why did you start eating people?”
target: “Cur ergo homines edere coepisti?”

source: He didn’t know which evil god corresponded to the Gourmet pathway.
target: Nesciebat cui deus malignus ad viam “Gourmet” pertineret.

source: Lez’s expression gradually darkened.
target: Vultus Lez paulatim obscuratus est.

source: “My wife had a friend who always filled her head with the idea of a luxurious lifestyle, introducing her to so‐called high society members, even encouraging her to have affairs and squander money.
target: “Uxor mea amicum habuit, qui semper eius mentem ideae vitae luxuriosae imbuere solebat, eam ad vocatos altos societatis introducens, atque etiam hortans ut amatoria se gereret et pecuniam disperderet.

source: She secretly mortgaged our restaurant; her goal was our restaurant from the start.
target: Ea arcane cauponam nostram hypothecavit; propositum eius ab initio caupona nostra erat.

source: After losing the restaurant, that friend stopped associating with my wife.
target: Post amissione caupona, ille amicus cum uxore mea consociari desiit.

source: My wife finally came to her senses but was too weak.
target: Uxor mea tandem ad se rediit, sed nimis debilis erat.

source: She burned down the restaurant, killing herself in the process.
target: Ea cauponam incendit, se in processu interficiente.

source: Then a regular customer, who admired my cooking skills, approached me and asked if I wanted revenge.
target: Tum comes ordinarius, qui artes meas culinarias admirabat, ad me accessit et rogavit: “Num ultionem velle?”

source: He offered to help, saying someone with my high-level cooking skills should worship the God of Cuisine, the great “Devouring Whirlpool.”
target: Auxilium offerre voluit, dicens aliquem cum meis altissimis artibus culinariis deum Coquinariae, magnum “Devorantem Turbinem,” adorare debere.

source: After that, I received a boon and slowly grew stronger.
target: Postea beneficium accepi et paulatim fortior factus sum.

source: After becoming a true Chef, I found that woman and made her into the most satisfying meal of my life.
target: Postquam verus coquus factus sum, illam feminam inveni et eam in prandium vitae meae maxime satisfaciens convertere feci.

source: From that day on, I enjoyed eating the flesh of the damned and gained the ability to discern who deserved to die.
target: Ex illa die, edendi carnem damnatorum mihi placuit et facultatem accepi ut discernerem quem mori merebat.

source: “Was that woman also a follower of an evil god?”
target: “Num illa femina quoque sectatrix dei maligni fuit?”

source: Hearing this, Lumian strongly suspected that the first person Lez ate was a bestowed of the Broker pathway.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian vehementer suspicatus est primum hominem quem Lez edisset esse concessum viae Broker.

source: Perhaps Lez’s restaurant was part of a transaction.
target: Forsitan caupona Lez pars negotii erat.

source: “Yes,” Lez confirmed, “She worshiped the so‐called Truth. When she met my wife, she was still weak.”
target: “Ita,” confirmavit Lez, “Ea quae dicitur Veritas adoravit. Cum uxorem meam convenit, adhuc debilis erat.”

source: As expected… Lumian smiled.
target: Ut exspectabatur… Lumian subridens fuit.

source: The ability to discern who deserves to die is quite useful.
target: Facultas discernendi quis mori mereatur est valde utilis.

source: When I capture a Broker pathway Sequence 7 or higher, I’ll leave it to Ludwig to handle.
target: Cum series viae Broker gradus VII aut superiores capiam, id Ludwig ad gerendum tradam.

source: After finishing the meal Lez prepared, Lumian nodded in satisfaction.
target: Postquam Lez prandium praeparaverat, Lumian satisfactione annuit.

source: “I’m willing to hire you as the chef for this bar.
target: “Paratus sum te conducere ut coquum huius tabernae

source: Let’s discuss your compensation and responsibilities.”
target: de compensatione et officiis tuis colloquamur.”

source: “All right,” Lez said, assuming a listening posture.
target: “Ita,” inquit Lez, se audienti animo parans.

source: Lumian picked up a white napkin and wiped his mouth.
target: Lumian linteolum album sustulit et os suum extergit.

source: “There’s quite a bit of wine left in the cellar.
target: “In cella adhuc multum vini remanet.

source: Clean up the bar, rebuild it, and display the wine.
target: Tabernam purga, eam refice, et vinum exhibe.

source: After that, you’ll be responsible for hiring and managing bartenders and waitstaff, as well as reestablishing contact with suppliers.”
target: Post hoc, tibi incumbet de conducto et administratione tabernariorum et ministrorum, necnon de relatu cum suppeditatoribus restituendo.

source: “That’s the job of a manager,” Lez noted, having run a restaurant before.
target: “Id est munus moderatoris,” inquit Lez, quoniam antea cauponam gerebat.

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “Yes, chef and manager.
target: “Ita, coquus et moderator.

source: The bar’s revenue, after costs, will all be yours.”
target: Omnis reditus tabernae, post expensas, tibi erit.

source: “What about you?”
target: “Et quid de te?”

source: Lez had never seen such an owner.
target: Lez talem dominum numquam viderat.

source: Not even wanting the money?
target: Nec pecuniam quidem quaerebat?

source: Lumian stood up, stretching his body, and casually said, “You’ll be responsible for my meals, cleaning my room, and if there are special ingredients, making dishes or cocktails that give me the corresponding traits.
target: Lumian surrexit, corpus extendens, et leve dixit: “Tibi incumbet de meis cibis curare, conclave meum purgare, et, si ingredientia specialia adsunt, fercula aut potiones parare quae mihi proprietates idoneas tribuant.

source: Also, I don’t eat human meat.”
target: Et etiam, carnem humanam non edo.

source: Lez stared at Lumian for a few seconds and said in a deep voice, “You seem to know a lot about a Chef’s abilities.”
target: Lez per paucos momenta Luminum aspexit et voce profunda dixit: “Videtur te multa de facultatibus coquorum scire.”

source: Lumian glanced at the now-stopped rain outside and walked towards the bar’s entrance, smiling.
target: Lumian pluviam, quae iam cessaverat, intuebatur et ad introitum tabernae ambulavit subridens.

source: “The previous owner of this bar was a Depriver, but unfortunately, I deprived him of his life, so he can’t share his culinary skills with you.”
target: “Prior dominus huius tabernae deprivator fuit, sed infeliciter, vitam eius abstuli, ideo artes culinarias suas tibi communicare non potest.”

source: Moreover, my godson is an Angel of your pathway.
target: Praeterea, nepos meus est Angelus viae tuae.

source: Lez fell silent.
target: Lez silentium tenuit.

source: As Lumian was about to leave the bar, he finally spoke, “I’ll take good care of this bar.”
target: Dum Lumian tabernam relinquere parabat, tandem locutus est: “Hanc tabernam bene curabo.”

source: Lumian didn’t look back, raising his right hand and waving lightly in acknowledgment.
target: Lumian non respexit, dextram manum levans et leve salutans.

source: There were still some deep pools of water on the street outside, with pedestrians mainly walking on the sidewalks.
target: Extra viam adhuc erant nonnullae profundae aquarum piscinae, cum viatores praesertim in semitis incedebant.

source: The sky was now bright and sunny, as if there hadn’t been a heavy rainstorm.
target: Caelum nunc clarum et serenum erat, quasi imber gravis non fuisset.

source: Following the subtle connection from the contract mark, Lumian walked towards the suspected location of the Abscessed Hand’s head.
target: Secundum subtilissimum nexum ex signo contractus, Lumian ad suspicatum locum capitis “Manus Abscessae” ambulavit.

source: Turning a corner, he saw a drenched corpse lying under a book-engraved obelisk.
target: Angulum vertebat, et vidit cadaver madide permeatum iacere sub obelisco libris insculpto.

source: It was Vijepan, the gloomy rapist-murderer who had been exiled to Morora with Lumian and others.
target: Erat Vijepan, lugubris stuprator et caedator, qui cum Lumiano aliisque in Morora exsulatus erat.

source: At this moment, his hands and feet were severed at the joints, his pants stripped off, and his groin a bloody mess with the most important part missing.
target: In hoc momento, manus et pedes eius ad nodos abscissi erant, bracae eius ablatae, et inguina eius, cum parte maximo deficiente, in sanguine confusa erant.

source: His eyes were wide open, frozen in pain and despair.
target: Oculi eius late patefacti erant, et in dolore atque desperatione immobiliter fixi erant.

source: Lost the duel, huh?
target: Certamen amisisti, nonne?

source: Lumian murmured with a silent laugh.
target: Lumian submurmuravit tacito risu.

source: He almost whistled in admiration for the duel he hadn’t witnessed.
target: Fere sibilavit ex admiratione certaminis, quem non viderat.

source: It must have been exciting; whoever died deserved a toast.
target: Excitans fuisse debuit; qui mortuus erat, poculo honorifico celebrandus erat.

source: Looks like that collector named Julie is stronger…
target: Videtur illa collector, quae “Julie” appellatur, fortior esse…

source: Both she and Vijepan had ulterior motives, no, open intentions to provoke a duel…
target: Et illa et Vijepan ulteriora consilia habebant, immo apertas intentiones certamen provocandi…

source: Lumian thought Julie was likely a Beyonder.
target: Lumian putavit Julie probabiliter Beyonder esse.

source: Such knife skills weren’t something an ordinary person could possess.
target: Tales peritiae cultrorum non erant, quas homo vulgaris possideret.

source: As for whether Vijepan was a Beyonder, Lumian couldn’t tell for now.
target: Quoad utrum Vijepan Beyonder esset, Lumian hoc nunc discernere non potuit.

source: Even if he was, his Beyonder characteristic should have been taken.
target: Etiamsi esset, eius natura Beyonder accipienda fuisse debuit.

source: “That woman is formidable,” a voice suddenly said beside Lumian.
target: “Illa femina formidabilis est,” subito vox iuxta Lumian dixit.

source: A gentleman had come from the side of the small square.
target: Quidam vir ex latere parvae plateae accessit.

source: He wore a half-high silk hat, a white shirt, a cashmere sweater, and a woolen suit jacket, with a bow tie and a cane in hand.
target: Ille habebat pileum sericum semialtum, tunicam albam, pallium cashmiri, et vestimentum laniferum, cum papilione et baculo in manu.

source: He looked just over thirty, with a thin face and gentle blue eyes, like a well-educated upper-class person.
target: Vix triginta annos videbatur, vultu tenuo et oculis caeruleis mitibus, quasi persona nobilis et erudita.

source: Of course, in Morora, there were no good people, only bad people and worse people.
target: Certe, in Morora, nulli boni erant, sed tantum mali et peiores.

source: “Did you see their fight?” Lumian asked casually.
target: “Pugnam eorum vidistine?” inquit Lumian leviter.

source: The gentleman smiled.
target: Vir ille subridens fuit.

source: “They initially wanted to borrow revolvers for a duel from the restaurant over there, but the waiter told them that there were too many duels today and all the guns were borrowed, leaving only two long swords.
target: “Initio revolvera a caupona illa pro duello mutuo capere voluerunt, sed ministrus illis dixit hodie nimium duella esse et omnia arma mutuaria, relinquens solum duas gladios longos.”

source: “That woman was very skilled.
target: “Illa femina valde perita erat.

source: This man blocked three strikes before being knocked down, having his hands and feet cut off, and his pants removed.”
target: Hic vir tres ictus impedivit antequam deiectus esset, manus et pedes eius abscissi, et bracae eius ablatae.

source: So Vijepan wasn’t likely a Beyonder…
target: Itaque Vijepan verisimiliter non erat Beyonder…

source: Lumian shifted his gaze from the corpse to the gentleman and asked with a smile, “What’s your name?”
target: Lumian oculos a cadavero ad virum convertit, subridens, et rogavit: “Quod nomen tibi est?”

source: The gentleman placed a hand on his chest and bowed.
target: Vir manum in pectore posuit et inclinavit.

source: “You can call me Gusain, or Count. I heard you killed Worms?”
target: “Me vocare potes Gusain, sive Comes. Audivi te Worms interfecisse?”

source: “Worms, the thief?” Lumian laughed.
target: “Worms, fur?” inquit Lumian ridens.

source: “He was struck by lightning, nothing to do with me.
target: “Fulguratus est, nihil ad me pertinet.

source: If I had killed him, the enforcers would have arrested me.”
target: Si eum interfecissem, custodes me arestassent.

source: Gusain smiled slightly.
target: Gusain leviter subridens est.

source: “There are ways to deceive the enforcers.”
target: “Sunt modi custodes decipiendi.”

source: So you’ve noticed their rigidity and procedural nature too?
target: Itaque etiam animadvertisti eorum rigiditatem et proceduralem naturam?

source: Lumian thought for a few seconds before deciding to be “honest.”
target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, antequam decreveret se “sincerum” esse.

source: “Worms died because he wasn’t lucky enough.
target: “Worms mortuus est, quia non satis fortunatus erat.

source: The item he stole from me attracts lightning during rain.”
target: Res, quam mihi abstulit, tempore pluviae fulgura allicit.

source: “Then you can’t be blamed,” Gusain said understandingly.
target: “Tum ergo te non reprehendi potest,” inquit Gusain.

source: He asked warmly, “How should I address you, and where are you staying now?”
target: Calide quaesivit: “Quomodo te appellare debeam, et ubi nunc residis?”

source: “Louis, staying at the Carnivore bar,” Lumian replied truthfully.
target: “Louis, in taberna Carnivora manens,” respondit Lumian sincere.

source: Gusain nodded slightly.
target: Gusain leviter annuit.

source: “Be wary of Bainar, the bar’s owner and chef. He’s dangerous and cannibalistic.”
target: “Cave Bainar, dominum et coquum tabernae. Is periculosus et anthropophagus est.”

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “He’s already dead.”
target: “Iste iam mortuus est.”

source: Gusain paused for a moment before smiling.
target: Gusain momentanea pausa fecit, deinde subridens.

source: “You’re more interesting than I expected.
target: “Es multo iucundior quam exspectabam,

source: I hope you bring long-lost vitality to Morora.”
target: spero te vitalitatem diu amissam Mororae afferre.”

source: Lumian didn’t continue the topic, instead taking the opportunity to gather information.
target: Lumian rem non continuavit, sed potius occasionem ad notitias colligendas arripuit.

source: “In Morora, apart from Heraberg from the Church of Knowledge, who else should I watch out for?”
target: “In Morora, praeter Heraberg de Ecclesia Scientiae, quem alium observare debeam?”

source: Without hesitation, Gusain replied, “Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company, has a monopoly on the grain supply from the surrounding farms to Morora.
target: Sine mora, Gusain respondit: “Wanak, dominus Societatis Agriculturae Dades, monopolium habet in copia grana ex agris circumfacentibus ad Mororam.”

source: He had become an experimental subject but suddenly escaped and now behaves like a normal person.
target: Factus erat subiectus experimentalis, sed repente effugit et nunc se gerit ut homo ordinarius.

source: He is the most dangerous one in Morora.”
target: Ipse est periculosissimus in Morora.

source: Can someone really return to normal after becoming an experimental subject?
target: Num quis vere ad statum normalem redire potest, postquam subiectus experimentalis factus est?

source: And the Church of Knowledge didn’t do anything about Wanak leaving the experimental group?
target: Et Ecclesia Scientiae nihil fecit de Wanak, discessisse a coetu experimentali?

source: This is exactly what I need…
target: Hoc est exacte quod mihi opus est…

source: Lumian thought to himself and nodded.
target: Lumian sibi ipsi meditabatur et annuit.

source: “Who is the second most dangerous person in Morora?”
target: “Quis est secundus maxime periculosus in Morora?”

source: Gusain’s smile remained unchanged as he answered, “They say it’s me.”
target: Risus Gusain immutatus restabat, cum respondit: “Dicunt me esse.”
